topic: Planning a child's college admission and fees years ahead, goal by goal
judge_note: Amma's gold and Appa's FD is a warm, familiar scene. I rewrote the English candidate into Tanglish and removed the sacrifice framing.

slides.headline: Amma gold-la, Appa FD-la save pannanga. Neenga enna-la?
slides.subhead: Child college goal-ku, year by year plan pannunga. Chinna monthly amount-la start pannalam.

slides.title: Planning a child's college, year by year

points.title: Know the timeline first
points.text: Note the admission year. Fees start then. Count how many years you have.

points.title: Add the monthly amount
points.text: ₹12 lakh in five years is about ₹20,000 monthly, before market ups and downs.

points.title: Same goal, another tool
points.text: Gold and FDs still have their place. This is one more way toward the same goal.

slides.headline: Save this for the next parent you meet.
slides.cta: Share it: college planning is a habit, not a burden.
slides.footnote: Fees may rise over time. Mutual funds are subject to market risks.

caption:
Kolandhai college-ku innum varusham irukku.

Ippove plan pannalama? Same habit as Amma and Appa, with one more tool. Market risks apply.

When does your child's college clock start?

#Chennai #NammaChennai #ParentingGoals #ChildrensEducation #SIP #MoneyHabits #TamilNadu
translation_en: Amma saved in gold, Appa in FDs. What will you save in? / Plan your child's college goal year by year. You can start with a small monthly amount. / There are still years left for your child's college. Shall we plan now?
